maddeler.e:
اصطبغت (form VIII)
# اِصْطَبَغْتُ (iṣṭabaḡtu) /isˤ.tˤa.baɣ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْطَبَغَ (iṣṭabaḡa)
# اِصْطَبَغْتَ (iṣṭabaḡta) /isˤ.tˤa.baɣ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْطَبَغَ (iṣṭabaḡa)
# اِصْطَبَغْتِ (iṣṭabaḡti) /isˤ.tˤa.baɣ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْطَبَغَ (iṣṭabaḡa)
# اِصْطَبَغَتْ (iṣṭabaḡat) /isˤ.tˤa.ba.ɣat/: thi
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
